MH_010.objective: To seize the AFOS fragment, wipe out the U.N. Forces.

MS_350.objective: Defend the Macross until its main gun fires.

MS_370.objective: Destroy the enemies nearing the Macross.
MS_370.briefing: Enemy units spotted approaching the Macross. A scramble has been ordered. Miss Macross may be on your mind, but go at once and wipe out the enemy.

MS_380.objective: Escort the Cat's Eye until the survey of the giant aliens is complete.

MS_400.briefing: The Zentradi have surrounded the Macross to stop it from returning to Earth. It's a hard-line move, but destroy the Zentradi to break their encirclement.

MS_410.objective: Wipe out the Zentradi forces that have attacked the Macross.
MS_410.briefing: The Zentradi have attacked the Macross, back on Earth after a year away. Wipe out the Zentradi forces trying to smoke the Macross out into space.

MS_420.objective: To keep the enemy off the Macross, wipe out the Zentradi forces.
MS_420.briefing: A Zentradi battleship is closing fast on the Macross as it resupplies at sea. We can't let the Macross's resupply be interrupted. Wipe out the Zentradi.

MS_421.objective: To keep the enemy off the Macross, wipe out the Zentradi forces.

MS_430.briefing: The Ontario Autonomous Zone has agreed to take in the Macross's civilians, but the Zentradi have appeared. Wipe them out so the civilians can be taken in.

MS_440.objective: Escort the liaison shuttle headed for U.N. Forces HQ on Earth.
MS_440.briefing: You'll now escort the liaison shuttle taking Capt. Hayase to U.N. HQ on Earth. Escort it until it reaches a safe zone, then switch to wiping out the enemy.

MS_450.objective: Beat the expert gamers at the smash-hit game "Battroid Attack".

MS_470.objective: To end the interstellar war, destroy Golg Boddole Zer.
MS_470.briefing: Fearing the power of Earth's culture, Boddole Zer attacks the Macross all-out. We'll use the Minmay Attack to overturn hopeless odds. Destroy Boddole Zer.

MS_210.objective: To capture the automated spaceship factory, seize control of the facility.

MS_230.briefing: Quamzin has taken civilians hostage and is demanding a battleship as ransom. Rescuing the hostages safely comes first. Wipe out Quamzin's faction.

MS_240.objective: Wipe out Quamzin's faction, which is trying to steal the reaction engine.

MS_250.objective: To protect the Macross and Macross City, wipe out Quamzin's faction.

MZ_320.objective: Annihilate the Micronian mobile weapons that have infiltrated the ship.

MZ_330.briefing: Ignoring the order to halt attacks on Micronians, Quamzin attacked their ship. We can't let Quamzin get ahead of us. We're launching our own attack too.

MP_320.briefing: Rioting Zentradi remnants have ignored a call to surrender and still run wild. To put down the riot at once, annihilate the Zentradi remnants.

MP_330.briefing: This test assesses your aptitude as a test pilot for Project Super Nova, the next main VF contest. Win the mock battle against the Valkyrie squad.

MP_340.briefing: A flight test now begins to measure the prototype's thrust, agility and more. Run a time trial to measure how long you take to clear all the waypoints.

MP_360.briefing: To gauge the prototype's combat ability, we'll now stage an arena mock battle. Battle a large number of targets, simulating combat against multiple enemies.

MP_370.objective: As a live combat test of the prototype, annihilate the Zentradi remnants.
MP_370.briefing: We've had reports of Zentradi remnants appearing from a planet near Eden. We'll now annihilate them, also as a live combat test of the prototype.

MP_380.objective: Stop the bombers escorted by VF-11s from reaching the target area.

MP_390.objective: Destroy the carrier escorted by VF-11s.

MP_400.objective: Destroy the base defended by VF-11s.

MP_410.objective: Defeat the rival aircraft in the competition.
MP_410.briefing: For head-to-head prototype data, we now hold a mock battle against the rival. Needless to say, it's the most crucial test for selection. Win at any cost.

M7_310.briefing: A vanguard craft reports to Battle 7 that an unknown force has ambushed it. Annihilate the unknown craft to keep them away from the Macross 7 fleet.

M7_315.briefing: A vanguard craft reports to Battle 7 that an unknown force has ambushed it. Annihilate the unknown craft to keep them away from the Macross 7 fleet.

M7_320.objective: As part of training, fight a mock battle against Gamlin.
M7_320.briefing: Danger always lurks on a journey through vast space. To prepare for the worst, beat Diamond Force member Lt. Gamlin Kizaki in a training mock battle.

M7_330.objective: Recover the containers holding citizens and annihilate the Varauta Army.
M7_330.briefing: Citizens kidnapped by the Varauta Army are being carried off in containers. Annihilate the Varauta escort and bring the containers to the designated area.

M7_340.objective: Retake the fold generator, then defend it and annihilate the Varauta Army.
M7_340.briefing: The Varauta Army is trying to re-fold City 7, now cut off from Battle 7. Retake the generator, annihilate the Varauta Army and stop the re-fold.

M7_360.briefing: Battle 7's relief escorts were wiped out instantly by a mysterious Varauta foe. Annihilate the Varauta Army to protect the citizens of City 7.

M7_370.briefing: Just as City 7 is dragged toward a blazing star, the Varauta Army attacks. Annihilate the Varauta Army at once and escape from the star.

M7_375.objective: Annihilate the Varauta Army that's blocking the escape from the blazing star.
M7_375.briefing: Just as City 7 is dragged toward a blazing star, the Varauta Army attacks. Annihilate the Varauta Army at once and escape from the star.

M7_380.objective: Annihilate the Varauta Army, which has launched a large-scale attack.
M7_380.briefing: Varauta forces struck suddenly near Lux. Macross 7 faces its worst crisis yet. Sink the Varauta flagship to break their chain of command and end this crisis.

M7_385.objective: Annihilate the Varauta Army, which has launched a large-scale attack.
M7_385.briefing: Varauta forces struck suddenly near Lux. Macross 7 faces its worst crisis yet. Sink the Varauta flagship to break their chain of command and end this crisis.

M7_390.briefing: We've spotted a likely Protodeviln, approx. 300 m long, unlike any foe so far. Make survival your top priority, and destroy the Protodeviln if possible.

M7_400.objective: Stop the Protodeviln coming to save their comrade from reaching the target area.
M7_400.briefing: We captured a Protodeviln, but let its would-be rescuers break into Battle 7. Annihilate the intruders and stop them from seizing the Protodeviln.

M7_410.briefing: The Protodeviln have gotten serious and are attacking the Macross 7 fleet. We can't let the Protodeviln beat us here. Annihilate the Varauta Army.

M7_420.objective: As part of training, fight a mock battle with the legendary duo.
M7_420.briefing: Ahead of the escalating Protodeviln war, a mock battle will now be held. Beat the married duo: a genius pilot of old in the latest model, and an ex-ace.

M7_430.briefing: We now launch Operation Stargazer, a surprise assault by a small elite force. Wipe out the Varauta Army at all costs to fire reaction weapons into the cave.

M7_440.briefing: Capt. Gamlin, possessed by the Protodeviln, is on a rampage, wrecking bases. We can't allow more damage. You're authorized to shoot down Capt. Gamlin.

MD_310.objective: Harvest Spiritia from the fleet where a Spiritia reaction was detected.
MD_310.briefing: Reviving our master, Lord Gepelnitchi, requires a vast amount of Spiritia. Attack the fleet showing a massive Spiritia reaction and harvest its Spiritia.

MD_320.objective: For Lord Gepelnitchi's plan, annihilate the wretched samples.
MD_320.briefing: To make Lord Gepelnitchi's dream, the "Spiritia Farm Project," a reality, we now begin our attack on the samples' flagship. Annihilate the samples.

MD_330.objective: Annihilate the samples who have launched a surprise attack.
MD_330.briefing: The fools! The samples have launched a surprise attack on our Varauta system. Show them that resistance is futile. Annihilate the samples at once.

MD_340.objective: Fight alongside Lord Gepelnitchi and annihilate those Anima Spiritia.
MD_340.briefing: The Anima Spiritia's power has at last revived Lord Gepelnitchi's true body. Fight beside the mighty Lord Gepelnitchi and annihilate those Anima Spiritia.

MG_010.briefing: Galaxy Whales are nearing orbit; we've detected likely poachers hunting them. Arrest them once confirmed. You may ignore the civilian craft also spotted.

MG_020.objective: As part of training, fight a mock battle against Patrol officers.
MG_020.briefing: When the Galaxy Whales near Zola, poachers flock to the planet in droves. To prepare, the Zolan Star Patrol holds its regular training: a mock battle.

MG_030.objective: Arrest the poachers trying to poach the Galaxy Whales.
MG_030.briefing: The Galaxy Whales are nearing Zola again: prime hunting season for poachers. We can't ignore their poaching any longer. Take the poachers into custody.

MG_040.objective: Escort Officer Liza to the target area and arrest the poachers.
MG_040.briefing: Undercover with the poachers, Officer Liza is trying to flee in a stolen VF-17. Escort her to the target area, then arrest the poachers and black marketeers.

MG_050.objective: Protect the Galaxy Whale from the reaction weapon and arrest the poachers.
MG_050.briefing: Poachers aim a reaction weapon at the white Galaxy Whale hampering their hunt. Protect the whale from the weapon at all costs and arrest the poachers.

MG_055.objective: Make Basara's song ring across the galaxy.
MG_055.briefing: Basara: "Sing to the whales? Heh, not just the whales! I'll make all of you          out here listen to my song! Here we go! Listen to my song!!"

MF_310.objective: To stop them from entering Island 1, annihilate the unknown lifeforms.
MF_310.briefing: An unknown enemy downed a New U.N. aircraft. Its heavy EM jamming seems to hide the details. Head to the scene at once and annihilate the enemy.

MF_311.objective: To stop them from entering Island 1, annihilate the unknown lifeforms.
MF_311.briefing: An unknown enemy downed a New U.N. aircraft. Its heavy EM jamming seems to hide the details. Head to the scene at once and annihilate the enemy.

MF_315.objective: To stop them from entering Island 1, annihilate the unknown lifeforms.
MF_315.briefing: An unknown enemy downed a New U.N. aircraft. Its heavy EM jamming seems to hide the details. Head to the scene at once and annihilate the enemy.

MF_316.objective: To stop them from entering Island 1, annihilate the unknown lifeforms.
MF_316.briefing: An unknown enemy downed a New U.N. aircraft. Its heavy EM jamming seems to hide the details. Head to the scene at once and annihilate the enemy.

MF_320.objective: As part of training, fight a mock battle against the New U.N. Forces.
MF_320.briefing: A mock battle now begins as our regular joint drill with the New U.N. Forces. Show them what S.M.S. can really do, and win the mock battle.

MF_330.briefing: The Victors that struck Macross Frontier never left; they seem to be hiding in Island 3's foundation block. Annihilate them before they near Island 1.

MF_340.objective: As part of the S.M.S. applicants' final test, fight a mock battle against Pixie Team.
MF_340.briefing: The final test for S.M.S. applicants begins now. To help out, join the applicants in a mock battle against Pixie Team, led by Capt. Klan Klang.

MF_350.objective: Scout the thieves' hideout, and if they attack, annihilate the thieves.
MF_350.briefing: The New U.N. Forces have asked us to scout a thieves' hideout. If the thieves attack once you're there, you are authorized to engage them.

MF_360.objective: As part of training, fight a mock battle against S.M.S. Skull Squadron.
MF_360.briefing: To prepare for Vajra attacks, a mock battle begins now. Beat Maj. Ozma Lee's Skull Squadron, one of the finest elite units in all of S.M.S.

MF_370.objective: To save the Galaxy fleet's surviving ships, wipe out the Vajra.
MF_370.briefing: We'll now rescue the surviving Macross Galaxy ships under Vajra attack. Wipe out the Vajra blocking the survivors' escape from the combat zone, now.

MF_371.objective: To save the Galaxy fleet's surviving ships, wipe out the Vajra.
MF_371.briefing: We'll now rescue the surviving Macross Galaxy ships under Vajra attack. Wipe out the Vajra blocking the survivors' escape from the combat zone, now.

MF_372.objective: To save the Galaxy fleet's surviving ships, wipe out the Vajra.
MF_372.briefing: We'll now rescue the surviving Macross Galaxy ships under Vajra attack. Wipe out the Vajra blocking the survivors' escape from the combat zone, now.

MF_375.objective: To save the Galaxy fleet's surviving ships, wipe out the Vajra.
MF_375.briefing: We'll now rescue the surviving Macross Galaxy ships under Vajra attack. Wipe out the Vajra blocking the survivors' escape from the combat zone, now.

MF_376.objective: To save the Galaxy fleet's surviving ships, wipe out the Vajra.
MF_376.briefing: We'll now rescue the surviving Macross Galaxy ships under Vajra attack. Wipe out the Vajra blocking the survivors' escape from the combat zone, now.

MF_377.objective: To save the Galaxy fleet's surviving ships, wipe out the Vajra.
MF_377.briefing: We'll now rescue the surviving Macross Galaxy ships under Vajra attack. Wipe out the Vajra blocking the survivors' escape from the combat zone, now.

MF_380.objective: Wipe out the Vajra that suddenly appeared during the survey of their nest.
MF_380.briefing: We found a Vajra nest and began a survey, aiming to grab a cocoon if possible, but the Vajra spotted us almost at once. Move swiftly to wipe them out.

MF_385.objective: Wipe out the Vajra that suddenly appeared during the survey of their nest.
MF_385.briefing: We found a Vajra nest and began a survey, aiming to grab a cocoon if possible, but the Vajra spotted us almost at once. Move swiftly to wipe them out.

MF_390.briefing: A concert tour crew visiting planet Gallia 4 to boost morale has been taken hostage by rioting Zentradi. Wipe out the rioting Zentradi to rescue them.

MF_395.briefing: A concert tour crew visiting planet Gallia 4 to boost morale has been taken hostage by rioting Zentradi. Wipe out the rioting Zentradi to rescue them.

MF_400.objective: Clear out all the Vajra cocoons aboard the Global.
MF_400.briefing: The Global, 117th Research Fleet flagship found on planet Gallia 4, has become a Vajra lair. To stop the Vajra breeding, clear out every Vajra cocoon aboard.

MF_401.objective: Clear out all the Vajra cocoons aboard the Global.
MF_401.briefing: The Global, 117th Research Fleet flagship found on planet Gallia 4, has become a Vajra lair. To stop the Vajra breeding, clear out every Vajra cocoon aboard.

MF_410.objective: Destroy the giant Vajra ship believed to be commanding the Vajra.
MF_410.briefing: Organized Vajra attacks have put the Frontier fleet in grave danger. Head for the giant Vajra ship believed to be giving orders. Destroy it at once.

MF_411.objective: Destroy the giant Vajra ship believed to be commanding the Vajra.
MF_411.briefing: Organized Vajra attacks have put the Frontier fleet in grave danger. Head for the giant Vajra ship believed to be giving orders. Destroy it at once.

MF_140.objective: Wipe out the Vajra so they can't disrupt the experiment using Ranka Lee's song.
MF_140.briefing: Top-secret mission: you will now guard an experiment using Ranka Lee's song. Until the experiment begins, wipe out the Vajra so they can't interfere.

MF_150.objective: Defend the Macross Quarter and wipe out the Vajra or survive for 5 minutes.
MF_150.briefing: Evolved Vajra have appeared that even reaction weapons can't harm. They will be hard to destroy, so put defending the Macross Quarter and your survival first.

MF_155.objective: Defend the Macross Quarter and wipe out the Vajra or survive for 5 minutes.
MF_155.briefing: Evolved Vajra have appeared that even reaction weapons can't harm. They will be hard to destroy, so put defending the Macross Quarter and your survival first.

MF_160.objective: Defend the Battle Frontier for 5 minutes as it prepares a super-long-distance fold.
MF_160.briefing: To end the war with the Vajra, a super-long-distance fold has been decided on. Defend the Battle Frontier until the super-long-distance fold begins.

MF_170.objective: Wipe out the Vajra rampaging inside the Frontier.
MF_170.briefing: A Vajra nest was apparently built inside Macross Frontier, and swarms of Vajra are rampaging inside. Wipe out the Vajra that have emerged in the Frontier.

MF_172.objective: Wipe out the Vajra rampaging inside the Frontier.
MF_172.briefing: A Vajra nest was apparently built inside Macross Frontier, and swarms of Vajra are rampaging inside. Wipe out the Vajra that have emerged in the Frontier.

MF_180.objective: Wipe out the deserters trying to escape in the stolen Macross Quarter.
MF_180.briefing: Some S.M.S. members are trying to hijack the Macross Quarter and escape. At this rate they'll fold away. You're authorized to shoot down the deserters.

MF_185.objective: To test the VF-171EX, hold a mock battle with the Sagittarius Squadron.
MF_185.briefing: A mock battle will now be held to test the VF-171EX, built to fight the Vajra. Defeat the Sagittarius Squadron in this combined machine test and training.

MF_190.objective: To make the Vajra homeworld ours, wipe out the Vajra.
MF_190.briefing: At last we've found the Vajra homeworld. Our only way to survive is to make it our new home. Wipe out the Vajra, powered by the Galactic Fairy's song.

MF_191.objective: To make the Vajra homeworld ours, wipe out the Vajra.
MF_191.briefing: At last we've found the Vajra homeworld. Our only way to survive is to make it our new home. Wipe out the Vajra, powered by the Galactic Fairy's song.

MF_200.objective: For the peace of the galaxy, defeat Grace O'Connor.
MF_200.briefing: Grace O'Connor's group, who'd use even the Vajra to seize the galaxy, were the true masterminds. For the peace of the galaxy, defeat Grace O'Connor.

MF_201.objective: For the peace of the galaxy, defeat Grace O'Connor.
MF_201.briefing: Grace O'Connor's group, who'd use even the Vajra to seize the galaxy, were the true masterminds. For the peace of the galaxy, defeat Grace O'Connor.

MF_205.objective: For the peace of the galaxy, defeat Grace O'Connor.
MF_205.briefing: Grace O'Connor's group, who'd use even the Vajra to seize the galaxy, were the true masterminds. For the peace of the galaxy, defeat Grace O'Connor.

MF_206.objective: For the peace of the galaxy, defeat Grace O'Connor.
MF_206.briefing: Grace O'Connor's group, who'd use even the Vajra to seize the galaxy, were the true masterminds. For the peace of the galaxy, defeat Grace O'Connor.

MY_310.objective: To rescue our kin, annihilate the unknown entities.
MY_310.briefing: We have detected a being that shares fold waves with us. To rescue that being, we shall annihilate the unknown entities.

MY_320.objective: Annihilate the unknown entities that hinder the rescue of our kin.
MY_320.briefing: Our kin, who are one and the same as us, must be rescued at all costs. We shall annihilate the unknown entities that hinder the rescue.

MY_330.objective: Annihilate the unknown entities that have appeared to hinder the rescue of our kin.
MY_330.briefing: We sensed our kin's fold waves and began a rescue, but new unknown entities appeared to hinder it. We shall annihilate the entities hindering the rescue.

MY_340.objective: Annihilate those who would invade the Vajra planet.
MY_340.briefing: Your key is in my hand, and the queen's throne is already mine. Go now, Vajra. My eyes, my ears, my limbs. Strike with your mighty claws!

ME_010.objective: Wipe out the rogue Zentradi forces.
ME_010.briefing: An unknown fleet, likely rogue Zentradi forces, has been spotted near Jupiter. Break the enemy's will to fight with Operation Minmay, then wipe them out.

ME_020.objective: Wipe out the mysterious mecha rampaging through the city.
ME_020.briefing: Mecha from a mysterious fleet slipped through our defenses and invaded Earth. Wipe out the mobile weapons ravaging the city as if seeking something. Now!

ME_030.objective: Wipe out the Mardook forces seeking to destroy Earth's culture.
ME_030.briefing: The Mardook forces have launched an all-out assault to destroy Earth's culture. Protect Earth's culture at all costs and wipe out the Mardook forces.

ME_040.objective: To retake the communications relay base, wipe out Vindirance.
ME_040.briefing: Starting the op to retake the relay base held by anti-U.N. group Vindirance. Infiltrate via the canyon leading to the base and wipe out Vindirance's guards.

ME_041.objective: To retake the communications relay base, wipe out Vindirance.
ME_041.briefing: Starting the op to retake the relay base held by anti-U.N. group Vindirance. Infiltrate via the canyon leading to the base and wipe out Vindirance's guards.

ME_050.objective: Wipe out Vindirance, who are scheming to fold to Earth.
ME_050.briefing: Vindirance is plotting a fold to Earth. It must be stopped at all costs, so reaction weapons are authorized for this operation. Wipe out Vindirance.

ME_060.objective: To shatter Latence's ambitions, destroy the Macross.
ME_060.briefing: We will now descend to Earth and infiltrate Macross City. To shatter Latence's ambitions, destroy the wide-area jamming system in the head of the Macross.

ME_100.objective: Defeat the variable fighters of all eras.
ME_100.briefing: Variable fighters, developed using the OverTechnology of the Macross. To learn how they evolved, battle the variable fighters of every generation.

ME_110.briefing: A massive Zentradi horde has appeared and is about to invade Earth once again. Protect Earth from this crisis: annihilate the Zentradi forces at all costs.

ME_120.objective: To be accepted as a security guard, fight a mock battle with Basara's band.
ME_120.briefing: Venue security test for Fire Bomber's special live: can you stay cool through Basara and the band's red-hot songs? Win the mock battle vs. Fire Bomber.

ME_130.objective: Fight wild with a burning heart!
ME_130.briefing: Basara: "Now it's red-hot live time! We'll slam our hearts right into you!          So let's go big and flashy! Get wild and FIRE!"

ME_140.objective: Make it out of Macross Heaven alive.
ME_140.briefing: The Macross that ended the interstellar war passed its name on to colony ships. Make it out alive from Macross Heaven, packed with ships bearing that name.

ME_150.objective: Wipe out the swarming hordes of small fry.
ME_150.briefing: The enemy is throwing sheer numbers at us. Teach them that "quality" beats "quantity" in battle: sweep away the small-fry horde in the wasteland at once.

ME_151.objective: Wipe out the swarming hordes of small fry.
ME_151.briefing: The enemy is throwing sheer numbers at us. Teach them that "quality" beats "quantity" in battle: sweep away the small-fry horde in the wasteland at once.

ME_160.objective: Set your ecstasy ablaze in a one-of-a-kind fight!
ME_160.briefing: Sheryl: "From here on, it's special live time. Are you ready, Ranka-chan?" Ranka: "Yes! So... everyone, hold me tight! To the ends of the galaxy!! Kira☆"

ME_170.objective: This is the day we take down Editorial Sentai Dengeki V, no matter what!
ME_170.briefing: Dr. Editor-in-Chief Nishioka formed Editorial Sentai Dengeki V for world peace! When these Dengeki editors' hearts unite, their giant robot smashes evil!!

ME_180.objective: Defeat the Famitsu editors blocking your probe and uncover the collection's secret.
ME_180.briefing: To guard a prized collection, Hamamura Tsushin made the Weekly Famitsu office a super dimension fortress. Find out what collection is worth going that far.

ME_190.objective: Annihilate the ones rampaging in the city who wield "giant" power.
ME_190.briefing: Wipe out the Regults rampaging in the city now, but we sense a "giant" power behind them, so never drop your guard. Annihilate those with "giant" power.

ME_200.objective: Win the mock battle against the special forces unit Moon Island Platoon.
ME_200.briefing: A mock battle now begins vs. the special forces unit codenamed "Moon Island". They're all problem children, but reportedly skilled. Defeat Moon Island.

MC_010.briefing: Roy Focker: the U.N. ace who loves booze, women, and above all the open sky. Defeat Focker, whose skills have made him the very model of a pilot.

MC_020.briefing: Shin Kudo washed up on Mayan Island and grew through the many people he met. Defeat Shin, the idiot who'd throw his life away for the woman he holds dear.

MC_030.objective: Seize victory from the duo of Ivanov and Nora.
MC_030.briefing: D.D. Ivanov and Nora Polyansky: the aces of the Anti-U.N. Forces. Defeat this dangerous couple, whose skills ran the U.N. Forces ragged.

MC_040.objective: Seize victory from the Bird Human.
MC_040.briefing: Sara Nome, Guide of the Wind, charged with stopping the Bird Human's revival. Defeat the Bird Human, revived in spite of all her efforts.

MC_050.objective: Seize victory from the genius Max and the ace Milia.
MC_050.briefing: Genius pilot Max and ace Milia, who made the first-ever interstellar marriage. Defeat the Jenius couple, also a bridge to peace with the Zentradi.

MC_060.briefing: Quamzin Kravshera, boss of the Quamzin family, notorious as the Ally Killer. Defeat Boss Quamzin, in such a fine mood he's riding a Destroid Monster.

MC_070.objective: Seize victory from Golg Boddole Zer.
MC_070.briefing: Golg Boddole Zer: Zentradi fleet Supreme Commander over a full 5 million ships. Defeat the ruthless Boddole Zer, who'd readily kill his own troops to win.

MC_080.objective: Seize victory from the duo of Isamu and Guld.
MC_080.briefing: Isamu and Guld: stuck together since childhood, they fight whenever they meet. Defeat the Dalmatian High School duo, seemingly at odds but friends at heart.

MC_090.briefing: Maximilian Jenius, space carrier Battle 7's captain and a commander of genius. Defeat the Battle 7, which fought its way through the fierce Protodeviln war.

MC_100.objective: Seize victory from Gavil and Glavil.
MC_100.briefing: Gavil, a Protodeviln with a unique sense of beauty, and Glavil, a monster-like Protodeviln of immense combat power. Defeat the Beauty and the Monster.

MC_110.briefing: His Excellency Gepelnitchi: Varauta supreme commander, mightiest Protodeviln. Defeat His Excellency Gepelnitchi, who could drain the galaxy of its Spiritia.

MC_120.briefing: Gamlin Kizaki, elite pilot of the U.N. Forces' Diamond Force. Defeat Gamlin, nicknamed "Martian" as a child for his wide forehead.

MC_130.objective: Seize victory from the duo of Basara and Graham.
MC_130.briefing: Graham, who hates and would kill the Galaxy Whales, and Basara, who was moved to sing to them. Defeat these men burning with passion for the whales.

MC_140.briefing: Ozma Lee: seasoned S.M.S. Skull Squadron leader, overprotective of his sister. Defeat Ozma, who smashed death flag after death flag throughout the story.

MC_150.objective: Seize victory from Jeffrey, captain of the Macross Quarter.
MC_150.briefing: The Macross Quarter: ARMD-class in size, yet it bears the name Macross. Defeat the Macross Quarter, captained by Jeffrey Wilder.

MC_160.briefing: Klan Klang, Pixie Team leader, clumsy not just in her genes but in love too. Defeat Klan, a maiden sunk in rage and grief after losing the one she loved.

MC_170.objective: Seize victory from the duo of Alto and Brera.
MC_170.briefing: "Being linked to you made it clear. However far you go, people are alone!" "That's why we...!", "But!!", "It's precisely because we're alone that...",

MC_180.briefing: Manipulated by Grace, Ranka Lee guards the Vajra planet to atone for her sins. Defeat Ranka, who sings to protect the Vajra homeworld.

MC_190.objective: Seize victory from the Vajra Queen.
MC_190.briefing: Even the Protoculture feared their power, envied it, and at last deified them, copying their form: the super-dimensional Vajra. Defeat Grace's Vajra Queen.

MC_200.objective: Seize victory from the enemy battleships new to the fight in this game.
MC_200.briefing: Macross is full of giant battleships, and needless to say, so is this game. Defeat the giant enemy battleships making their debut in this game.

MT_010.briefing: Ranka: "I, Ranka Lee, am gonna explain the basic Fighter mode controls!         I'm nervous I won't explain it well, but I'll do my best. Kira☆"

MT_011.briefing: Sheryl: "Oh, fine. I'll explain the basic Battroid mode controls for you.          Sheryl herself is explaining, so don't you dare miss a single word."

MT_012.briefing: Ranka: "Okay! Next, I'll explain the basic GERWALK mode controls.         Listen to me and get the GERWALK mode controls down perfectly!"

MT_020.briefing: Sheryl: "It's a pain, but next I'll explain the basics of shooting attacks.          You've got ME explaining, so if you don't learn it, you'll be sorry."

MT_021.briefing: Ranka: "Umm... here I'll explain the basics of melee attacks.         It's tough with so much to learn, but I'll do my best explaining too!"

MT_030.briefing: Sheryl: "Here I'll mostly explain the special maneuvers related to piloting.          If you're aiming to go pro, you'd better learn at least this much."

MT_031.briefing: Ranka: "Here I'll mainly explain the SP-related special maneuvers.         They look a bit hard, but listen closely and learn them well, okay?"

MT_032.briefing: Sheryl: "All right, next I'll explain container transport.          I'm the one explaining it. Of course you'll pick it up right away."

MT_040.objective: Practice piloting in Real Flight Mode.
MT_040.briefing: Ranka: "Sheryl and I are going to show you how to fly in Real Flight Mode!" Sheryl: "You don't get service like this very often, so be grateful."

MT_041.briefing: Sheryl: "Here I'll explain the controls that changed since the previous game." Ranka: "Explaining with Sheryl makes me nervous, but I'll do my best!"

MT_042.briefing: Ranka: "The last lesson is about the Anti-Missile Action." Sheryl: "Keep up with our lessons at Macross speed!"

MT_100.objective: Train at the ground training field.
MT_100.briefing: Sheryl: "Now you're going to do combat training at the ground training field.          There are targets on the field too, so train however you like."

MT_110.objective: Train at the space training field.
MT_110.briefing: Ranka: "Now you're going to do combat training at the space training field!         There are targets on the field too, so train however you like!"

MT_120.objective: Train at the in-base training field.
MT_120.briefing: Sheryl: "Now you're going to do combat training at the in-base training field.          There are targets on the field too, so train however you like."

MT_130.objective: Train at the indoor training field.
MT_130.briefing: Ranka: "Now you're going to do combat training at the indoor training field!         There are targets on the field too, so train however you like!"

MT_140.objective: Train at the flight training field.
MT_140.briefing: Sheryl: "Now you're going to do combat training at the flight training field.          There are targets on the field too, so train however you like."
